title: Mono Basin terrain: USGS 3DEP 1 m DEM manifest, mosaic, crop and 16-bit World Partition heightmap tiles
phase: Phase 5 - Mono Basin corridor (moved ahead by ADR 0006)
forbidden_dependencies: Committing raw or derived rasters to git
acceptance_criteria: DONE: CONFIG: world box, source project, supplementary projects, output spacing and landscape layout live in tools/world/terrain_config.json.
DONE: Z SCALE and GRID: heightmap_math.py (formula world_z_cm = actor_z + (count - 32768) * ScaleZ / 128, ScaleZ = span * 100 / 512 rounded up; component grid; ring nodata fill), 18 unit tests.

DONE: FETCH: fetch_dem.py queries the TNM API, downloads 18 tiles (15 CA_SierraNevada_B22 primary + 2 CA_YosemiteNP_2019_D19 and 1 NV_WestCentral_EarthMRI_2020_D20 supplementary, 3.52 GB) in parallel with resume, records size and SHA-256 per tile in data/manifests/dem_CA_SierraNevada_B22.json.

DONE: TILES: build_heightmap.py mosaics the primary tiles first and lets supplementary tiles fill only empty cells, resamples to 2 m by area average, and writes 266 16-bit PNG tiles of 1009 x 1009 vertices (14 x 19 tiles, 112 x 152 landscape components) plus heightmap.json. Real run: 0 cells without data, elevation 1945.39 to 3979.90 m, ScaleZ 405.178285, 3.17 cm per count, actor Z 2962.65 m. The first run with the primary project alone had 7.3 million empty cells over Yosemite National Park (Mount Dana flattened to 3830 m); the supplementary tiles fixed that.
DONE: SYNTHETIC TESTS: 36 world tests pass (python -m unittest discover -s tools/world/tests -t tools/world), including mosaic, seam and nodata fill on synthetic GeoTIFF tiles.
DONE: REAL RUN CHECK: verify_heightmap.py reads 12 benchmark places back from the PNG tiles: median difference to the source DEM 0.01 m (max 0.08 m), to the USGS point service 0.03 m (max 0.21 m).
NOT DONE (belongs to T-0103): importing the tiles into an Unreal World Partition Landscape.
